translations.answer: Use the same XML, initial qpos/qvel/ctrl values, and run both mjx.forward→mjx.step and mj_forward→mj_step sequentially to print NaNs. Perform single-variable ablation on float64, integrator, timestep, actuator/transfer, and fixed base. If these changes do not affect the first step NaN in MJX or native MuJoCo, then a high-quality minimal reproducible example can be formed, but it cannot be claimed as the root cause until the maintainer locates it.
translations.applicability: MuJoCo 3.3.7/MJX corresponding environment and similar constraint/transfer models.
translations.credibility.rationale: The solution has not closed or there is a conflict; the problem is only partially identified.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Run MJX and native MuJoCo with the same XML/initial state.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Check qpos/qvel after forward and step.
translations.details.diagnostics.2: Ablate precision, integrator, timestep, actuator/transfer, and fixed base.
translations.details.environments.0: macOS darwin 24.3.0; Python 3.12; MuJoCo 3.3.7; bundled MJX; JAX CPU build.
translations.details.limits.0: No known root cause or fix; minimal model includes tendon/constraint combination, cannot infer all MJX leg models will fail.
translations.details.outcomes.0: All ablations still show NaN in MJX first step, while native MuJoCo is stable; Issue remains open.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How to establish a differential reproduction when the same model is stable in native MuJoCo and shows NaN in MJX first step?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Any policy/state with NaN must be intercepted by watchdog before entering the actuator interface.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Numerical implementation or support difference in MJX for this constraint/transfer combination; root cause not confirmed by maintainer.
translations.details.symptoms.0: mjx.forward has no NaN; first mjx.step qpos/qvel is NaN; native mj_step is stable for 5 steps.
translations.source.locator: Issue #2932 setup, observations, minimal XML, and reproduction script.
